SATORI_TEA_MEMORY_POWER.title: Tea Break
SATORI_TEA_MEMORY_POWER.description: At the start of your next {Amount} turns, Read Mind a random enemy once.
SATORI_KING_DISDAIN_POWER.title: King's Disdain
SATORI_KING_DISDAIN_POWER.description:
Whenever you apply Mental Load, also apply 3 Suggestion.
Whenever you apply Suggestion, also apply 3 Mental Load.
SATORI_MIST_POWER.title: Misty Haze
SATORI_MENTAL_SHIELD_POWER.title: Mental Shield
SATORI_MENTAL_SHIELD_POWER.description: You cannot gain debuffs until your next turn begins.
SATORI_TEMPORARY_FOCUS_POWER.title: Temporary Focus
SATORI_WHISPER_POWER.title: Whispered Dominion
SATORI_WHISPER_POWER.description: Apply {Amount} Mental Load to ALL enemies for each Skill played this turn.
SATORI_MIRROR_HALL_POWER.title: Memory Hall
SATORI_MIRROR_HALL_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, Read Mind the leftmost enemy {Amount} time(s).
SATORI_ECHO_POWER.title: Mind Echo
SATORI_ECHO_POWER.description: Each Mind Echo adds 1 damage and Block to Memory cards. Every 2 stacks add 1 Strength, Weak, and Vulnerable, rounded down.
SATORI_RESONANCE_POWER.title: Companionship
SATORI_RESONANCE_POWER.description: Whenever you play a Memory card, gain {Amount} Block.
SATORI_STATIC_POWER.title: Unceasing Static
SATORI_STATIC_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, apply {Amount} Mental Load to ALL enemies.
SATORI_FEEDBACK_POWER.title: Verbal Echo
SATORI_FEEDBACK_POWER.description: Before an enemy with Mental Load attacks, gain {Amount} Block.
SATORI_DREAM_STUDY_POWER.title: Palace Library
SATORI_DREAM_STUDY_POWER.description: Whenever you play a Memory card, draw {Amount} card(s).
SATORI_RED_STRINGS_POWER.title: Red-Thread Network
SATORI_RED_STRINGS_POWER.description: Whenever an enemy loses all Suggestion, immediately apply {Amount} Suggestion to it.
SATORI_PUPPET_THEATER_POWER.title: Puppet Theater
SATORI_PUPPET_THEATER_POWER.description: After you play an Attack, apply {Amount} Suggestion to each enemy it hit.
SATORI_DREAD_AURA_POWER.title: Dread Aura
SATORI_DREAD_AURA_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, apply {Amount} Suggestion to ALL enemies.
SATORI_NIGHTMARE_POWER.title: A Girl's Nightmare
SATORI_NIGHTMARE_POWER.description: Mental Load triggers at the start of the enemy turn instead.
SATORI_DEEP_SEA_POWER.title: Deep-Sea Consciousness
SATORI_DEEP_SEA_POWER.description: Whenever you apply Mental Load, apply {Amount} additional stack(s).
SATORI_RUPTURE_POWER.title: A Letter from Old Hell
SATORI_RUPTURE_POWER.description: Temporary cards you gain this combat are Upgraded. Does not stack.
SATORI_FOCUS_POWER.title: Satori the Girl
SATORI_FOCUS_POWER.description: Every 5 Memory cards you play, gain {Amount} Mind Echo.
SATORI_MIND_WARD_POWER.title: Mind Barrier
SATORI_MIND_WARD_POWER.description: Legacy Mind Barrier. No longer active.
SATORI_PERFECT_MEMORY_POWER.title: Omniscience
SATORI_PERFECT_MEMORY_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Amount} Mind Echo.
SATORI_CALM_POWER.title: Calm Heart
SATORI_CALM_POWER.description: When Suggestion is consumed, consume only half, rounded up. Does not stack.
SATORI_MEMORY_PALACE_POWER.title: Memory Palace
SATORI_MEMORY_PALACE_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, draw {Amount} card(s).
SATORI_EXTRA_TURN_POWER.title: Extra Turn
SATORI_EXTRA_TURN_POWER.description: After your turn ends, take {Amount} extra turn(s).
SATORI_MIND_SOVEREIGN_POWER.title: Mind Sovereignty
SATORI_MIND_SOVEREIGN_POWER.description: The first time you Read Mind each turn, create {Amount} extra copy of each Memory card gained.
SATORI_SUGGESTION_POWER.title: Suggestion
SATORI_SUGGESTION_POWER.description: When you would take damage from this enemy, consume Suggestion to gain the same amount of Block.
SATORI_DISCORD_POWER.title: Discord
SATORI_DISCORD_POWER.description: Below 5 stacks, each stack reduces Attack damage dealt to the applier by 10%. At 5 or more, consume 5 stacks to redirect the next Attack action to another enemy, or itself if alone. Redirected attacks are not reduced by Discord.
SATORI_MENTAL_LOAD_POWER.title: Mental Load
SATORI_MENTAL_LOAD_POWER.description: At the end of the enemy turn, take damage equal to the stacks. Damage is increased by 50% if the enemy has an Attack intent.
SATORI_DAMPENED_INTENT_POWER.title: Dulled
SATORI_DAMPENED_INTENT_POWER.description: Attacks deal {Amount} less damage this turn.
SATORI_ECHO_POWER.smartDescription: Memory card damage and Block +{Amount}. Strength, Weak, and Vulnerable bonuses are halved, rounded down.
SATORI_MIND_POWER.title: Memory Record
SATORI_MIND_POWER.description: Records memories and card order during combat.
SATORI_UNSEEN_PRESENCE_POWER.title: Unnoticed · Intangible
SATORI_UNSEEN_PRESENCE_POWER.description:
Damage and HP loss are capped at 1. This does not expire.
Shared party progress: {Progress}/{Goal}. Each participant adds 4 to the goal; anyone playing a Heart Knot adds 1 progress. A fallen player waives 4 from the goal once, keeping earned progress. On completion, break Intangible permanently and Exhaust all Heart Knots.
SATORI_UNCONSCIOUS_INTENT_POWER.title: Unconscious Actions
SATORI_UNCONSCIOUS_INTENT_POWER.descript:
All intents appear as a single ? until execution. Read Mind reads their true types. Heavy attacks are announced beforehand.
At half HP or below, her next action additionally removes all debuffs and grants 5 Strength. Triggers once.
